lever2_shared_kv_passes.why: the KV-sourced ME op (ot_qwen_w12_matvec mmode 1) puts the context positions on the lanes and the query heads on the IL = 8 interleave slots; its time is slots x K steps, independent of how many KV words are read. Each position's scores op already fills all 8 slots (8 query heads), so two positions in one op need 16 slots: the same cycles as two ops.
lever2_shared_kv_passes.where_the_attention_time_is: the per-position softmax stream op: 8 heads x 8,188 scores / 64 SU lanes = 1,023 cycles of work (measured ~1,161 a position), issued 4 times; it scales with the stream-unit width, not with K/V reads
